areas.name: Completion Planner
areas.location_cue: The profile screen, Chapter Select menu, Journal, and gadget loadout screen before a replay.
areas.note: Checkpoint replay prevents permanent content loss, but the single-autosave model and delayed registration justify a separate safety profile.

levels.1: Use a separate profile before major cleanup passes.
levels.2: The campaign uses one autosave per profile, while additional profile slots preserve independent runs.
levels.3: Before a major campaign transition or the last item of a collectible family, leave the active profile untouched and copy the local PC save directory or begin the safety run in another profile slot. Checkpoint replay handles ordinary misses, but a backup protects against delayed collection registration.

levels.1: Later tools reveal or open routes that early exploration cannot finish.
levels.2: For collectible cleanup, carry the yellow-scan watch function, Dart Phone, and Laser Strap.
levels.3: The watch scan arrives automatically in the gadget workshop and highlights nearby interactables. The Dart Phone opens distraction and pickpocket routes, while the later Laser Strap breaks specified locks, cabinets, vents, and glass. If checkpoint replay supplies the wrong tools, replay from the preceding gadget-lab section and keep that loadout into the target area.

levels.1: Open the Journal before and after each focused attempt.
levels.2: Challenge progress requires an online connection and normally saves after its condition or checkpoint boundary registers.
levels.3: Stay connected, pin one or two compatible Journal entries, satisfy them, and wait for their completion marks before leaving. You may then exit or select another checkpoint; a full area replay is usually unnecessary. If a valid attempt fails to register, restart from the checkpoint before the challenge window rather than reloading inside it.

save_backup.title: Create a safety copy before cleanup
save_backup.why: Each profile has only one autosave, and collection registration can occasionally be delayed.
save_backup.detail: Use another profile slot or copy the local PC save before collecting the last item in a family.
